items.title: George "Jug" Jernberg Interview, 1963-08-23
items.q: And little Lester Allen, that comedian that was with White Scandals, he was there.

ctx.x: And little Lester Allen, that comedian that was with White Scandals, he was there. All kinds of big people in show business. They were all at that party that night. I can't remember all of them.
Because theater treasures had a close contact with them.
